newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway gas supply committee to plan new fields.
newsitem.headline: Norway gas supply committee to plan new fields.

text.p: A plan for phasing in new gas fields and transport systems is to be drawn up the Norway's Gas Supply Committee (FU) for the Energy Ministry, Den Norske Stats Oljeselskap ASA's (Statoil) Status Weekly newsletter said on Thursday.

The plans will be based on various levels of Norwegian natural gas sales up to around 80 billion cubic metres per year. They will also cover supply solutions for existing gas contracts which have yet to be allocated to a field.
Statoil said no final date had been set for the new round of allocations, when the authorities will decide which fields should be developed to deliver gas under these contracts.
The FU comprises Statoil, Norsk Hydro, Saga Petroleum, Total, Shell, Conoco, Elf, Esso, Neste, Phillips, Mobil and Agip.
Under current sales, Norwegian gas exports to continental Europe are expected to hit around 62 billion cubic metres per year by 2005.
